# NotebookLM

NotebookLM Enterprise is Google's licensed, source-grounded notebook service for organizing sources in global-location deployments.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/notebook-lm/.

## Actions

- **Add Text Sources**: Add one or more named raw-text sources to a NotebookLM Enterprise notebook.
- **Create Audio Overview**: Start asynchronous generation of a NotebookLM Enterprise audio overview from selected notebook sources.
- **Create Notebook**: Create a NotebookLM Enterprise notebook in a licensed Google Cloud project and location.
- **Delete Audio Overview**: Permanently delete an audio overview from a NotebookLM Enterprise notebook.
- **Delete Notebooks**: Permanently delete one or more NotebookLM Enterprise notebooks by notebook ID.
- **Delete Sources**: Permanently remove one or more sources from a NotebookLM Enterprise notebook.
- **Get Notebook** (read-only): Retrieve a NotebookLM Enterprise notebook and its current source metadata.
- **Get Source** (read-only): Retrieve a notebook source's ingestion status, metadata, and failure reason.
- **List Recent Notebooks** (read-only): List up to 500 NotebookLM Enterprise notebooks ordered by when the connected user last viewed them.
- **Share Notebook**: Grant, change, or remove account access to a NotebookLM Enterprise notebook.
- **Upload Source File**: Upload a plain-text file as a source in a NotebookLM Enterprise notebook.
